name: membership-tiers
title: Membership tiers
description: A loyalty or membership ladder: tiers earned by spend or time, with thresholds, perks and a marker for where the member stands.
docs: Pass title, description, tiers (three or four, lowest first, each with an id, a name, a threshold written as you want it read and a list of perks) and optionally cta (the action under the ladder) and note (fine print). The tiers are an ordered list joined by a rail: columns from 768px of width for up to three tiers and from 896px for four, and one under the other with the rail on the left below that. Without more it is the ladder a visitor sees and nothing is marked. Give it the member's tier as current and how far they are as progress (a value and nextAt, with a currency such as EUR or a unit such as months) and their own tier carries aria-current and the words Your tier, the tiers below it say Reached, the rail is filled up to a marker between the member's tier and the next, and a progress bar says the same in numbers and in words, such as 180 euros to go until Gold. The rail is decoration; everything it shows is also said in text. labels translates the fixed words and locale formats the numbers.
